attr.title: Remnants of Naezith
attr.desc: With the powers granted to him by the dragon, Kayra will destroy the Remnants of Naezith, enchanted fragments of the dragon's body, to prevent anyone from exploiting their power for evil. Rush and swing through levels to top the leaderboards in this fast-paced, grappling hook precision platformer.
attr.inst: Purchase the game on Steam and use the Steam console to download the Linux build with these two commands: `download_depot 590590 590591 271869356780381257` and `download_depot 590590 590593 1978461534159709910`. Merge both downloads and copy everything (the `naezith` binary, `lib` and `data` folders) into `ports/naezith/gamedata/`.
attr.inst_md: Purchase the game on [Steam](https://store.steampowered.com/app/590590/Remnants_of_Naezith/) and use the [Steam console](https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=873543244) to download the Linux build with these two commands: `download_depot 590590 590591 271869356780381257` and `download_depot 590590 590593 1978461534159709910`. Merge both downloads and copy everything (the `naezith` binary, `lib` and `data` folders) into `ports/naezith/gamedata/`.
